A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SARSteer research and contain complete, readable main text and appendices. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, figures, tables, and supplementary material.

before.justification: v2 reports original SARSteer safety and utility experiments, ablations, robustness tests, repeated-seed results, and human evaluation in Sections 3 and 5 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, robustness experiments, and the 500-sample human evaluation in Appendix B.11.

M1.justification: Text-derived refusal steering, PCA-based safe-space ablation, and inference-time activation updates remain identical in Section 4, Equations 9–13, and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same benchmark coverage: Figstep-audio, AdvBench-audio, SORRY-Bench-audio, AJailBench, and AirBench, alongside the same appendix evaluations of text-only inputs, natural speech characteristics, and adversarial scenarios.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain No Defense, AdaShield, FSD, MDSteer-h2s, and MDSteer-c2r. RRS remains in Appendix B.6/Table 11, and the comparator membership in the newer-model comparisons is unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported splits, metrics, model configurations, and testing procedures are unchanged, including 100 alignment pairs, scaling coefficient 0.1, and 10 principal components. Appendix attack settings and human-evaluation protocols also match.

E4.justification: The component and hyperparameter studies in Figures 4–5, refusal-prompt and PCA alternatives, representation analyses, natural-speech and adversarial robustness tests, and human-judge and sample-level analyses were already present in v2 and remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same five seeds and per-run results, averages, and variances in Table 15. The statistical procedures in Appendix B.13, including Welch’s t-test and Cohen’s d, are also unchanged.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains SARSteer’s Figstep-audio ASR of 10.80% for Qwen2-Audio and 10.00% for Kimi-Audio.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–22 are retained, including BRR, the steering decomposition, Appendix A.4’s local-linearization argument, and Appendix B.13’s sample-level alignment definition.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution bullets, and conclusion retain the same claims about paired audio datasets, limitations of transferred defenses, and SARSteer’s ability to improve harmful-query refusal while preserving benign utility.

C2.justification: Interpretations of the modality gap, over-refusal, and PCA selectivity are unchanged, as are discussions of limited RRS training data, judge bias, and attack transfer. The Impact Statement is relocated and reformatted without changing its substance.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, dataset construction, prompts, hyperparameters, refusal-matching phrases, and the code/data release statement remain unchanged. The new funding acknowledgements add no technical or resource-access information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and research positioning. Reference entries reflow across pages without additions, removals, or substantive revisions.

P1.justification: v3 adds a financial conflict disclosure and funding acknowledgements, adds an author asterisk, corrects the running-header text and supplementary-title hyphenation, and gives the Impact Statement a separate heading. Scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain stable.

P2.justification: Template running headers are replaced by the paper title, and the additions reflow main-text paragraphs, footnotes, and references. The Impact Statement moves from page 8 to page 9, and Figure 2 shifts vertically. Figure graphics, captions, and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves transparency through explicit funding and financial conflict disclosures and improves presentation by replacing leftover template headers and correcting the supplementary title. The scientific evidence, reasoning, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to disclosure and editorial quality.
